MetaData.author: Second Product Rentals Team

searchData.contentSummary: Generic second product rental content used to prove that a second Pumpkin CMS tenant can power the same frontend.

content.headline: Second Product Rental Proof
content.subheadline: Use this placeholder-safe page to verify separate tenant content, routing, navigation, metadata, and conversion paths for a second rental domain.

content.title: Second tenant proof areas
content.subtitle: Each section is generic by design and can be replaced with production-specific content later.

cards.title: Rental overview
cards.description: Confirm that a second product page renders from the second tenant instead of the default tenant.

cards.title: Planning details
cards.description: Use neutral planning copy to test cards, links, layout, and metadata without production claims.

cards.title: Quote flow
cards.description: Submit a local proof request and verify that the FormEntry belongs to the second tenant.

content.title: How the second-site proof should work

steps.title: Seed tenant
steps.text: Run the seed tool with SITE_KEY set to second-product-rentals and a local-only API hash.

steps.title: Set app env
steps.text: Add the matching tenant id and plain local API key to the frontend's local environment file.

steps.title: Open host
steps.text: Browse through second.localhost:3002 so the app resolves the second site definition.

steps.title: Verify entries
steps.text: Check pages, sitemap, and contact form submissions against the second tenant.

content.title: Rental proof FAQ
content.subtitle: This proof keeps the data generic until a real second domain is selected.

items.question: Why use generic content?
items.answer: Generic content avoids duplicate production copy while still proving tenant isolation, rendering, sitemap, and form behavior.

items.question: Can this page be indexed?
items.answer: No. The seed uses noindex metadata because this is a local proof and not final production content.

items.question: What should change before launch?
items.answer: Replace the product details, page copy, theme, metadata, structured data, contact details, and canonical URLs.

content.title: Test the second-site quote path
content.description: Use the contact page to verify that submissions are stored for the second tenant.
